name: Animation Finishing
description: Still-image finishing choices derived from animation production; no extra frames or motion are generated.
author: NidAll

styles.name: Contour cadence
styles.description: Line thickness changes deliberately along supplied silhouettes.

clauses.text: Vary line thickness in measured intervals along the existing silhouette
Keep joints, facial features when present, and requested lettering distinct from adjacent lines
tags: distinct identifying lines and supplied lettering

styles.name: Two-zone shadow cel
styles.description: Two broad shadow groups simplify illumination while retaining form.

clauses.text: Organize existing form shading into one clear light group and one broad shadow group
Reserve small transitions only where needed to distinguish overlapping supplied forms

styles.name: Colored shadow-side line
styles.description: Contour hue changes only inside existing shadow regions.

clauses.text: Shift existing shadow-side contours away from pure black toward a nearby local hue
Retain dark separation at essential overlaps and inside supplied letterforms
tags: dark essential overlaps and letter interiors

styles.name: Dry graphite cleanup
styles.description: Dry, broken drawing edges retain controlled construction.

clauses.text: Use lightly broken dry-graphite edges along the supplied drawing contours
Resolve identifying features with firmer strokes while peripheral construction remains light
tags: firm identifying strokes and light peripheral construction

styles.name: Paint-edge drift
styles.description: Slightly imperfect fill registration creates a handmade cel surface.

clauses.text: Let painted fills drift slightly within existing contours without crossing important boundaries
Keep small supplied symbols and lettering outside the drift treatment
tags: supplied symbols and lettering free of drift

styles.name: Optical composite bloom
styles.description: Bright cel regions meet a soft optical compositing fringe.

clauses.text: Add a narrow soft bloom only where existing bright shapes meet darker neighbors
Use a fine common grain that binds foreground and background rendering

styles.name: Background paint economy
styles.description: Secondary depth receives broader marks than the supplied focal content.

clauses.text: Describe already supplied secondary depth with broader marks than the focal subject
Keep focal identifying contours crisp relative to peripheral painted edges
tags: focal contour clarity against painted peripheral edges

styles.name: Ink-trap junctions
styles.description: Line junctions open slightly instead of forming clogged dark knots.

clauses.text: Open tiny gaps at crowded existing line junctions to avoid solid dark knots
Retain the topology of supplied shapes and every requested letter while opening those junctions
tags: preserved shape topology and requested letters
